 Man at center of Williamson County Silver Alert found dead, TBI says 
 Guangxue Li, 61, was last seen in Brentwood on Nov. 7 before authorities found him dead, according to the TBI. 
 By Jaxon Steward Published : Nov. 8, 2026 at 5:36 PM CST | Updated : 4 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google WILLIAMSON COUNTY, Tenn. (WSMV) - A 61-year-old man who was the subject of a Silver Alert after he went missing in Brentwood has been found dead, the Tennessee Bureau of Investigation said.
 Guangxue Li, 61, was last seen in Brentwood on Nov. 7 before authorities found him dead, according to the TBI. (Tennessee Bureau of Investigation) Authorities found Guangxue Li deceased Sunday afternoon, the TBI said in a social media post. 
 The agency did not immediately release his cause of death or say where he was found.
 Li was last seen Nov. 7 in Brentwood and was believed to be traveling on foot, according to the TBI. The agency previously said he had a medical condition that could impair his ability to return safely without assistance.
